contribution_diagnostics: Omitted: per-variable attribution is ambiguous under correlated covariance, so no contribution column is invented.
limitations: The 10 sensors remain exploratory candidates (P3-001 found no q < 0.05 sensor); T² violations are multivariate anomalies, not confirmed defects. No causal interpretation; nothing tuned on Phase II labels; sensor selection unchanged.
methodology: T²(x) = (x - mu)' S^-1 (x - mu) with mu and the conventional sample covariance S estimated from Phase I pass complete cases after per-sensor Phase I standardization; the identical Phase I transform scores Phase II. Control limit is the finite-sample F-based UCL for one future observation. Incomplete lots are excluded without imputation and counted in coverage. Overlap counts are descriptive lot coincidences, not quality metrics.
